lines.text: A fourteen-year-old kid built a miniature star inside his suburban garage.
And it reached five hundred million degrees.
Taylor Wilson was obsessed with nuclear physics before high school.
For his birthday, he asked for radioactive elements and a Geiger counter.
He collected uranium ore and scavenged parts across internet forums.
In his parents' garage, he assembled a real nuclear fusion reactor.
At fourteen, he achieved nuclear fusion, smashing atoms together.
Federal agents showed up in utter disbelief at what he built.
President Obama invited him straight to the White House.
The government even offered him secret homeland security grants.
Because while other kids were playing video games, this teenager...
